Your focus is on making deployed AI better: finding the next opportunity, optimizing what is already live, piloting new Cresta capabilities, and proving the business impact. You are analytical, commercially minded, and credible with senior stakeholders in CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT. You are technical enough to work closely with FDEs and FDPMs and to give product and engineering a tight feedback loop. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Agentic AI
jobs.description_text: About The Role Autonomous driving software today improves mostly by hand: engineers collect data, train models, and tune modules. This role explores a different approach, in which AI agents take part in that work. Agents propose changes to policy code, data, training recipes, or model code. They then evaluate the results, diagnose failures, and turn verified fixes into reusable skills and data for the next round. With DiDi Voyager's real-world driving data and large-scale evaluation infrastructure, the goal is a loop that produces improvements that generalize across scenarios, pass safety gates, and reach the vehicle. The role combines machine learning, agentic systems, and autonomous driving, and will help shape both the onboard architecture and how driving software is developed. Responsibilities Build agentic harnesses for autonomous driving. Agents get permissioned access to the driving stack, data, training infrastructure, and evaluation environments, along with automatic scenario setup and pass/fail checks, so they can run experiments without a person in every step. Develop recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops. These include failure mining, candidate generation, evolutionary search, and targeted data generation aimed at the policy's current weaknesses. Each round should also improve the process that produces the next one. Curate a reusable skill library. jobs.title: Maintenance Technician - Cortland at Coalton
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As a Maintenance Technician, you ensure the community remains safe, functional, and well‑maintained by diagnosing and repairing a wide range of building and apartment systems. You provide timely, high‑quality service to residents, support preventative maintenance programs, and help preserve the property’s physical assets through consistent care and attention. Diagnose, repair, and resolve maintenance issues involving electrical, plumbing, HVAC systems, appliances, flooring, stairs, railings, and other building components. Correct unsafe conditions such as broken lights, damaged gates, open holes, or other hazards, ensuring issues are addressed quickly and safely. Support asset preservation by monitoring and reporting on the condition of building and security systems such as automatic doors and surveillance cameras. Schedule and perform preventative maintenance on HVAC units, equipment, and building systems to improve performance and reduce downtime. Maintain appropriate inventory of supplies and spare parts to ensure timely completion of work orders. Respond to on ‑ call rotations and emergency maintenance situations, assisting with both resident and property needs. Provide friendly, professional service when interacting with residents and team members. Document completed work and report recurring issues or safety concerns to your supervisor. Qualifications EPA certification required (Type I, II, or Universal). 1–3+ years of experience in maintenance, facilities

jobs.title: Graphic and Labels Freelance Designer
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW Alo is seeking a talented and highly creative Freelance Graphic Designer to support the development of original graphics across our apparel and accessories collections. This individual will work closely with the Design team to conceptualize, develop, and execute compelling graphic designs that reflect Alo’s elevated aesthetic and connection to fashion, performance, and contemporary culture. The ideal candidate possesses a strong visual point of view, exceptional typography and composition skills, and a refined understanding of how graphics translate onto physical products. jobs.title: Retail Support Specialist
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW The Retail Support Specialist is a key member of the Tier 2 Retail IT team, responsible for providing day-to-day technical support to retail stores and supporting New Store Opening (NSO) activities. This role focuses on timely issue resolution, high-quality customer service, and consistent execution of established IT processes. The Retail Support Specialist works closely with peers, the Senior RSD, and the RSD Manager to resolve incidents, fulfill requests, and ensure retail technology operates reliably and efficiently. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide Tier 2 technical support for retail stores and NSO activities, including troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and POS issues. Own and manage assigned tickets through resolution, ensuring timely updates, proper documentation, and customer communication. Follow established troubleshooting processes, runbooks, and escalation paths when handling incidents and service requests. The Visual Lead will work closely with Operations & Visual Managers in initiating, delegating work, and providing feedback to the team to achieve optimal results supporting total store operations. Duties require constant movement in and around the store, including the sales floor and back of house. When not actively assisting guests, this position takes initiative to perform other tasks, as needed, to keep store clean, safe, inviting and operating efficiently. jobs.title: Launch Program Manager - Contract
jobs.description_text: Our customers are utilities managing a complex electrical grid, supporting the daily lives of millions of people. Our Implementation Services team is seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the launch of new programs and integrations with our utility clients. This role will facilitate the onboarding of utility customers for thermostat, battery, and EV programs that enable flexibility at all levels of the grid. The Program Manager will work in close partnership with our Client Success, Partner Solutions, Marketing, and Engineering teams. This is an execution-focused engagement for a strong program manager with experience in the energy sector and a proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional launches. Scope of Work Program launch support: Support the implementation and launch of EnergyHub's thermostat, battery, and EV programs with utility clients, delivering program launch content, developing project plans, and coordinating work streams against dedicated launch timelines. jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description_text: Electric vehicles are one of the fastest-growing distributed energy resources on our platform. Through integrations with major automakers and charger manufacturers, EnergyHub ingests telematics and charging data from a large and rapidly expanding fleet of EVs enrolled in utility managed charging programs. EnergyHub's EV team is hiring a Data Analyst to turn that data into insight: understanding how drivers charge, how programs perform, where our data falls short, and where the next product opportunities lie. Your work will shape how utilities, automakers, and EnergyHub itself understand EV load, and will directly inform the products we build next. The ideal candidate is passionate about data analytics, curious about how people actually use their EVs, and motivated to apply their skills to solving the climate crisis. Main Responsibilities Analyze large-scale EV telematics and charging data from multiple OEM and charger integrations to surface insights into driver charging behavior, program enrollment and retention, event participation, and load shifting outcomes. Define, monitor, and improve data quality for EV OEM data feeds: identify gaps, latency, duplicates, and anomalies across sources, build automated checks, and work with engineering and OEM partners to resolve root causes. jobs.description_text: The Devices Team is responsible for the creation and lifecycle management of IoT devices enrolled in EnergyHub programs used to balance the power grid. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the scalability and flexibility of our future by creating a core platform that enables other internal teams to build new features and functionality quickly. This is an opportunity to join a highly energized team of engineers eager to define and develop key concepts, solve complex challenges with real-world constraints and have a positive impact on our climate future. We are continuing our journey to migrate from a monolithic to a microservices architecture and deliver well defined APIs to the broader organization. The primary focus is to integrate any Distributed Energy Resource (DER) into our platform in a way that enables multiple use cases without compromising quality and scalability. As a senior engineer, you support our mission by helping drive major initiatives, providing expertise and guidance from past industry experience, and autonomously developing high-quality solutions that balance multiple constraints while ensuring long-term flexibility. The ecommerce team here is strong on execution: merchandising runs a disciplined calendar, site operations ship reliably, and the testing program has high throughput. What it needs is a leader who defines the customer problem, decides which few bets are worth making, and prioritizes the team’s workload. You will report to the VP of Growth Marketing and lead a team of eight across merchandising, experimentation, and site operations, with four direct reports. You will work in close partnership with engineering, paid media, lifecycle, creative, and merchandising. Key responsibilities: The site strategy. Define the customer problem, the insight behind our approach, and the three or four bets that follow. Write it in prose, defend it with numbers, and revisit it quarterly. A single roadmap. One prioritized list across merchandising, experimentation, marketing, and product, sequenced against the constraint. The experimentation standard. jobs.title: Manager or Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations - Telehealth
jobs.description_text: About the role: Patiently™ is a multi-condition telehealth business helping consumers use tax-advantaged healthcare dollars for treatment and care. As we scale our condition roadmap, we need a strong operator and strategic thinker to build and run the operational foundation of the business. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between resolving an immediate patient or partner issue and building the processes, metrics, and cadence to scale. The right person thrives in an evolving environment — comfortable building 0-to-1 workstreams, creating structure where none exists, and driving results across internal and external partners. You will own day-to-day coordination and performance across clinical and provider workflows, pharmacy and fulfillment partners, customer support, and platform partners — working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Analytics, CS, Finance, and Operations to remove constraints and build a repeatable operating system as Patiently scales. Key responsibilities: Care delivery operations Manage the day-to-day operating relationship with Patiently's clinical, provider, and telehealth-platform partners. Ensure patients move smoothly from intake through provider review, treatment, and ongoing care. Identify workflow breakdowns and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve root causes.
